pins: An agent step whose result field name contains an unsafe path character (here, a dot) trips the spill guard's containment check and halts with spill-path-unsafe before any writer dispatch is attempted, once that field's content exceeds the 40000-byte inline threshold. Spec validation inspects only the spec block; scriptedOutputs is a test-harness mock of what a live agent would return and is not validated, so the unsafe key is invisible until dispatch time. spillDir is present only to satisfy validateSpec's agent-step requirement and is never written, because the run halts on the unsafe key before any writer dispatch is attempted.
scriptedOutputsShape: Ordered array of objects with fields stepId and output, consumed by dispatch call order (index 0 first). This spec has a single agent step and no writer dispatch ever occurs (the guard halts before any writer step is reached), so this fixture's scriptedOutputs array has exactly one entry, whose output is the agent's own oversized result object (not a plain string, unlike uncertain-gate.json's single string output) -- the shape allows any JSON value under output. Same ordered {stepId, output} array contract used by all four edge fixtures (sentinel-halt.json, uncertain-gate.json, spill-guard-violation.json, branch-no-match-no-default.json).
